name: booking
description: Rooms, guests and bookings with time-range and capacity rules and a status enum.

input.requirements: A room booking system. Rooms have a unique name, a capacity (more than 0) and an optional floor. Guests have a full_name, a unique email and an optional phone. A guest books a room for a period: a booking has starts_at and ends_at timestamps (the end must be after the start), and a status of confirmed or cancelled (default confirmed). Rooms and guests that have bookings cannot be deleted.
